slides.label: How to run a college club
slides.title: Your club *survives graduation.*
slides.lede: One Space, your team, clear roles and a crew for every event. Set up in 10 minutes.

slides.title: Set up your Space
slides.text: Name, link and one line about your club. Every event, member and rupee lives here, not on one laptop.

slides.title: Add your core team
slides.text: Search for their Unifesto account and add them. Two Space Admins: the president and one backup.

slides.title: Decide who can do what
slides.text: Curator runs the event. Co-Curator helps. Crew scans passes at the gate. *Money stays with the Curator.*

slides.title: Start an event with a name
slides.text: It stays a draft. The checklist shows what's left before you publish.

slides.title: Give each event a crew
slides.text: Pick people from your Space, set their role for that event only. *Crew at the fest, Curator at the workshop.*

slides.title: Hand it to next year's lead
slides.text: Transfer the Space when you graduate. Every event, count and report stays with the club.

slides.title: Your president graduates. *Your club doesn't.*
slides.lede: Free for RSVP events. Set up your Space in 10 minutes.
